subject.title: fix(zalo): prevent Bot API requests from hanging

question: Should OpenClaw make 30 seconds the default failure budget for existing ordinary Zalo Bot API operations, with only long polling and hosted-photo sending receiving explicit longer budgets?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but it intentionally converts previously unbounded slow requests into failures and establishes an operational compatibility policy for an existing channel.

options.title: Accept the bounded timeout policy
options.body: Adopt the 30-second default with the explicit long-poll and 150-second hosted-photo exceptions, accepting bounded failures instead of indefinite channel stalls.

options.title: Choose different operation budgets
options.body: Keep the shared deadline design but direct narrower or longer budgets for particular Zalo operations before merge.

options.title: Pause for Zalo owner evidence
options.body: Hold the PR until production observations or channel-owner guidance establish a different compatibility budget.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded timeout policy
recommendation.body: Adopt the 30-second default with the explicit long-poll and 150-second hosted-photo exceptions, accepting bounded failures instead of indefinite channel stalls.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most concrete evidence and implementation context currently available, though current-main ownership history remains unresolved.
